setup.refusal.title: Source preparation stopped
setup.refusal.requestLimit: A serialized provider request exceeds the 32,000-byte limit
setup.refusal.body: No grant was saved. No text was sent. Revise the source scope or import a smaller document before sending. Retrying this unchanged scope will report the same limit.
jobs.title: Study progress
jobs.intro: Follow each approved step without showing private source passages or provider responses.
jobs.charges: Accepted calls can incur charges even when their outcome is unknown. No provider or model changes here.
jobs.error.unavailable: Jobs unavailable; showing last recorded state.
jobs.error.changed: This job changed. Refresh before deciding.
jobs.error.decision: Decision unavailable. Review the current setup.
jobs.empty: No jobs on a current approved setup. Begin from your sources.
jobs.budget: Calls remaining in setup: {setup} of 64 · This run: {run} · Explicit retries remaining: {retries}
jobs.provider: Provider: {provider} · {model}. Provider charges not returned; token counts are not currency.
jobs.cancelRequested: Cancellation requested; an accepted call may still finish or incur a charge.
jobs.unknown.title: Outcome unknown
jobs.unknown.body: The provider may have accepted this call and charged for it. Do not treat its usage as zero. Stopping will not undo a charge; retrying may spend again. Choose and confirm a decision.
jobs.decision.stopConfirm: I understand stopping cannot retract an accepted call or its charge.
jobs.decision.retryConfirm: I approve a new provider call that may incur another charge.
jobs.retry.charge: Another provider call may incur a charge.
jobs.retry.auto: No automatic retry or model change.
jobs.retry.unavailable: Retry unavailable: inspect the current approval, call budget or retry limit.
jobs.paused: Pause requires review of the current setup or budget. No automatic provider change.
jobs.coverage.note: Stage completion is not proof that the model processed the whole document. Receipts account for transmitted ranges, not semantic understanding.
jobs.coverage.ranges: {sent} ranges transmitted from {reviewed} reviewed ranges. Window-only requests do not cover the entire reviewed text.
jobs.coverage.untransmitted: Not transmitted in this payload: {range} — outside this stage window
jobs.coverage.none: No range receipts available. Queued, rejected or unknown-outcome work does not establish transmission coverage.
jobs.coverage.inputLimit: Request or source budget limit prevented completion. No automatic truncation or summarization was used.

brief.status.outdated: Outdated: setup or answers changed. Save a new revision.
brief.title: Reading brief
brief.intro: Review the direction before approving. No outline is generated here.
brief.saveError: Unable to save this decision. It may be stale or incomplete. Review the current brief and try again.
brief.scope.note: Source scope comes from study setup. Changing it requires reviewing a new brief.
brief.selected: Selected: {choice}. Alternatives never replace your question automatically.
brief.editor.refinedNote: The original stays unchanged. Select the alternative only if it expresses your intent.
brief.editor.supportNote: Up to three; leave unused pairs blank.
brief.editor.saveNote: Saving creates a new revision and invalidates earlier approval and descendants. It does not start generation.
revision.title: Study revisions
revision.intro: Keep one edition, explore another lens. Each study keeps its own answers and reading goal.
revision.error: This decision is stale or unavailable. Review the current setup and try again.
revision.fork.note: Reuse matching analysis, not answers, approvals or transmission consent. The original stays unchanged.
revision.provider.title: Change provider
revision.provider.label: Provider and model
revision.provider.note: A new setup invalidates downstream approvals. No other provider’s cached map is used. Nothing is sent by this action.
revision.consent.title: Fresh provider consent
revision.destination: Destination: {provider} · {model}. Book text only; no reader context or derived study material.
revision.charges: Provider API charges may apply. Approval saves permission only; it does not start generation.
revision.credentials: API credential missing. Configure this provider on the server first.
revision.history.retained: Retained for lineage, not current approval.
revision.history.exports: Old successful exports remain versioned after edits.
outline.title: Study outline
outline.fixture: Fixture provider only; no live generation or cloud transmission.
outline.provider: Provider-backed outline requests are queued under the approved transmission grant; refresh to review the result.
outline.blocked: Live generation blocked: no live outline provider is configured. Fixture verification is separate.
outline.error: Unable to proceed: stale revision, missing approval or unresolved flags. Review the current outline.
outline.briefRequired: Approve the current reading brief before generating an outline.
outline.lessonQueued: Approved. Bilingual lesson generation is queued; refresh the evidence page to review the result.
outline.fixtureApproved: Approval recorded. Section generation is not implemented in Task18.
outline.sectionsBlocked: Section generation blocked until this exact outline is approved.
outline.question: Approved question {n}:
outline.illustrative: Illustrative model — not an author claim
outline.noQualifications: No qualifications recorded in this analysis; this is not a claim that none exist.
evidence.unavailable: This lesson is outdated or unavailable. Review the current approved outline and lesson.
evidence.title: Evidence and privacy
evidence.error: Unable to proceed: stale review, invalid correction or unresolved privacy flag.
evidence.state.ready: Ready for later publication approval; not published.
evidence.sourceBroken: Broken locators or unsupported quotations cannot be acknowledged away.
evidence.sourceMatched: Locators and quotations match stored text. This does not establish semantic support.
evidence.meaningNote: Compare claims with source passages, retained caveats, both languages and visual assumptions. Correct or remove content below, or explicitly acknowledge uncertainty. Acknowledged does not mean verified.
evidence.privacyNote: Screened {count} projected values. Screening assists review; it cannot guarantee anonymization. Inspect names, identifying situations and private source details in both languages. Privacy flags cannot be waived.
evidence.privateDetail: Known private detail or translated alias
evidence.confirmPrivacy: Confirm privacy review of all projected content
evidence.privacyStatus: Privacy review: {status}. Every content change requires a new review.
publication.state.failed: Export error — revise and approve again
publication.title: Publication
publication.intro: Only the cleaned content below enters these files. Downloads remain owner-only; sharing a downloaded copy is your choice.
publication.error: Stale review or output error. Reload and review the current version before deciding.
publication.note: Every edit invalidates approval. Publish pins this review and renderer; it does not make a public URL.
publication.exportUi.note: This fixes file controls, not lesson content. It is independent of the app language and cannot change after Publish.
publication.history.retry: If generation fails or is interrupted, choose Revise, review again, then Publish a new version. Existing successful files are retained.
publication.versionedNote: Files are versioned. Downloading never changes the approved copy.

setup.saveError: Setup could not be saved. Please try again.
setup.decisionError: Decision could not be saved. Please try again.
setup.approvedNote: Your provider and source scope are saved. Analysis is not queued until its stage is available.
setup.cancelledNote: No cloud work was queued. This draft cannot authorize transmission.
setup.consentSaved: Consent saved for this exact setup.
setup.title: Set up a study
setup.intro: Choose what leaves this device. Nothing is sent until you review and approve transmission.
setup.scope.whole: Whole document — all extracted text, including supplementary parts
setup.scope.incomplete: Some main chapters are unavailable. Only explicit partial scope is possible.
setup.caps: Studio caps: 64 calls, 32,000 request bytes, 6,000 output tokens. Codex output is checked after receipt.
setup.connection.title: Connection methods
setup.connection.keyNote: OpenRouter and Anthropic use server-owned API keys. Those keys stay separate from the official Codex connection below.
setup.connection.note: Sign in through the official Codex route for this private reading workspace. Connecting or disconnecting here does not change any provider API key.
setup.connection.models: Codex models are available to this workspace.
setup.connection.noModels: No Codex models are available to this workspace. Connect, then refresh after completing sign-in.
setup.connection.error: Official Codex route unavailable. No study was sent.
setup.review.scope: Scope: {scope}. Sending authorizes selected book text, analysis-derived study material and, after you approve a reading brief, that brief’s reader context to the selected provider for this exact setup. No excluded resources or unapproved drafts are sent.
setup.review.coverage: Extraction coverage: {coverage}. This describes local text extraction, not transmission or model processing.
setup.review.original: Original-file attachment unavailable: exact EPUB/DOCX support for this provider/model is unverified. Send authorizes text only. An original can contain omitted or out-of-scope material and would require separate reviewed consent.
setup.review.windows: All extracted text in the reviewed scope is accounted for. Work may use bounded source windows; a request, context or budget limit stops work without silently truncating it. A successful response does not establish whole-document processing. Check study progress for failures and incomplete work.
setup.review.limits: Studio limits: 64 calls; 32,000 serialized request bytes and 6,000 output tokens per call; up to 2 explicitly approved transient retries and 1 malformed-output repair. All attempts count toward the call budget. Codex does not enforce the studio output cap; an oversized reply pauses the job after receipt.
setup.review.timeouts: Timeouts with an unknown outcome pause for your decision. Providers may charge for accepted attempts. No provider switching or hidden retries.
setup.review.providerUnavailable: Selected provider unavailable. Configure its server key or official Codex connection, then refresh.
setup.apiNote: API access is separate from ChatGPT or Claude chat subscriptions. Keys stay on the server.
preview.title: Cleaned projection preview
preview.acknowledged: Semantic uncertainty acknowledged, not verified truth.
preview.human: Semantic judgments are human review, not proof of truth.
